brief: The viewer stands within a vast, echoing architectural space dominated by monolithic, curved planes of heavy steel. These sheets are textured with a distinctive, mottled rust, establishing a weighty presence against the emptiness of the hall. The pathway defined by the steel curves in an endless, sweeping arc before abruptly making a sharply perpendicular shift, creating a jarring visual interruption. The scale and fixed geometry of the pathway dominate the scene, appearing static and permanent, defined solely by its own imposing structure.

statement: This sketch presents an architectural space dominated by monolithic, curved steel planes that create a sense of weight and permanence. The composition features a series of arched steel sheets arranged in a circular pattern, each one textured with a mottled rust finish to emphasize their material presence. A dramatic perpendicular shift interrupts the continuous arc at the center, creating a jarring visual break that emphasizes the fixed geometry and imposing structure of the space. The scene is rendered in a static, immersive environment where viewers can observe the interplay of light and shadow on the steel surfaces, with the entire composition rotating slowly to reveal different aspects of its curved forms. The work captures the feeling of standing within a vast, echoing architectural hall defined solely by its own imposing structure.
